title: Publish genuine paper runtime bridge and causal lag observations

root_cause_analysis.bridge_identity_absence: PaperFleetReconciler._worker_env previously omitted forwarding verified engine bridge and context metadata from binding / binding.metadata, resulting in worker runtime context loaded: false and bridge reporting degraded in owner evaluation.
root_cause_analysis.context_bootstrap: PaperRuntimeService did not initialize PantheonRuntimeContext from manifest or environment when runtime_context was not explicitly injected, preventing fallback telemetry from accessing bridge attributes.
root_cause_analysis.causal_lag_absence: PaperRuntimeService did not measure causal queue lag strictly from genuine signal enqueue timestamps, and previously risked falling back to generic event timestamps; RuntimeTelemetryEmitter did not record genuine HTTP delivery latency, leaving delivery_lag_ms / event_delivery_lag_ms absent.
root_cause_analysis.unverified_and_conflicting_bridge_remedi: Binding metadata presence is not installed/executed bridge provenance. Catalog tags or nonexistent paths must not derive false healthy bridge status. Conflicting top-level vs metadata values or unverified repo / nonexistent installed paths must fail closed and remain degraded/omitted rather than falling back to inherited environment variables or guessing defaults.

remediation.paper_fleet_reconciler: In _worker_env, clear inherited bridge env vars, use _extract_verified_bridge to verify bridge repo against ALLOWED_ENGINE_BRIDGE_REMOTES and path against ALLOWED_ENGINE_BRIDGE_SOURCE_PATHS with actual installed existence on disk. Retain conflict fail-closed without falling back to inherited env. Only inject verified bridge environment variables when authentic, leaving absent/unverified bridge degraded.
remediation.runtime_context: In _normalize_payload, check for conflicts between top-level binding and metadata values, raising RuntimeContextError on conflict; preserve strict validation semantics requiring bridge.path in ALLOWED_ENGINE_BRIDGE_SOURCE_PATHS without validator widening or casefold.
remediation.telemetry_emitter: Record monotonic roundtrip elapsed time across urllib.request.urlopen in emit_payload as last_delivery_lag_ms; expose in snapshot; support extra_metrics in emit_heartbeat; in _base_metadata use _extract_verified_bridge to omit conflicting, unverified, uninstalled or absent bridge attributes without guessing adapter versions or context sources so bridge status stays degraded.
remediation.paper_runtime: Initialize PantheonRuntimeContext from manifest/env if omitted in PaperRuntimeService; measure causal queue lag strictly from genuine signal enqueue observations (enqueued_at or causal_queue_receipt); missing/unverifiable timestamps stay strictly None/degraded without fallback to generic event timestamps or creation times.

test_results.services/execution/lean_runtime/test_pap: 75 passed (including queue lag degraded/causal receipt tests, catalog-known-not-installed omission, conflict fail-closed without inherited env fallback, and unverified/conflicting bridge omission tests)
test_results.services/execution/lean_runtime/test_run: 16 passed (including conflicting provenance and uninstalled bridge path rejection tests)

invariants_preserved: Zero financial validator, cash/price arithmetic, or threshold modifications
Missing timestamps and unobserved telemetry delivery remain explicit None/null (degraded state), never faked or defaulted to 0
Unverified, conflicting, or nonexistent bridge paths stay degraded and do not emit false healthy bridge telemetry or fall back to inherited env
No external credentials, tokens, or live trading routes altered
